title: A $1,899 Canon Just Ended Sony's Nine-Month Run at the Top in Japan
excerpt: The Canon EOS R8 Mark II topped Japan's biggest camera chart in its first weeks on sale, ending the Sony A7 V's nine-month run. The reason is a lesson in what learners actually buy: light, capable, and affordable.

title: Sirui's New $499 and $599 Fast Primes Make Wide-Angle Affordable Again
excerpt: Sirui's Aurora line goes wider with a 15mm f/1.6 for $599 and a 24mm f/1.4 for $499, both autofocus, for Sony E and L-mount. Fast wide glass at this price changes what a learner can practice.

title: Good Lighting Can Still Be the Wrong Lighting
excerpt: Karl Taylor shows how the same subject, lit two ways, tells two different stories. Technically correct light is only half the job. The light has to serve the story you are telling.
